title: Add partial refunds
summary: Two stages: model the refunded amount, then wire it through the payout job.

stages.name: Model the refund
stages.purpose: Store how much of an order was refunded.

steps.text: Add a RefundedAmount field to Order
steps.change: New nullable column and a getter that never exceeds the order total.
steps.risk: The Order status enum is read in 4 places (refund-flow).

steps.text: Reject a refund larger than the remaining balance
steps.change: Throw RefundTooLargeError before calling the provider.

goNoGo.passWhen: all green and no new lint errors

steps.change: Subtract RefundedAmount from the payout total.

goNoGo.check: Run the payout job on the staging fixture
goNoGo.passWhen: the net amount matches the hand calculation

assumptions: The payment provider supports partial capture (only inferred in refund-flow).
